page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.e3.3xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance configured with 16 vCPUs across 8 physical cores and 128 GB of system memory. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor operating at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture, the instance provides dedicated CPU core execution via the KVM hypervisor. The processor incorporates 33 MB of L3 cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache per core, and hardware instruction support including AVX, AVX-512F, AES, and FMA. The instance does not include integrated GPUs or bundled local storage, requiring network-attached block storage for operating system and data volumes.

Benchmark results demonstrate a clear profile favoring multi-threaded execution over raw single-core speed. Single-core performance occupies the lower tier, with a Geekbench single-core score of 956.0 and a stress-ng single-core score of 1107.68, reflected in limited single-threaded compression throughput. In contrast, parallel multi-threaded testing reaches mid-tier output, producing a Geekbench multi-core score of 7731.0 and a PassMark CPU score of 18251.16. Memory performance tests record an uncached read bandwidth of 86.27 GB/sec and uncached write bandwidth of 48.78 GB/sec for large 256 MB blocks.

Application and server test suites confirm balanced operational throughput, registering 21.19 million Redis SET operations per second and 11.38 GB/sec in static web serving benchmarks. With a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8 GB per vCPU, the hardware profile delivers memory capacity efficiency over per-thread compute density. The platform is best suited for memory-intensive applications, in-memory caching layers such as Redis, enterprise relational databases, ETL processing pipelines, and multi-threaded enterprise services.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.e3.3xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine offering 16 dedicated vCPUs across 8 physical cores powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor at 2.5 GHz, paired with 128 GB of RAM. Operating under KVM virtualization on the x86_64 architecture, the CPU provides 33 MB of L3 cache and supports AVX-512F instruction sets. The server lacks bundled local disk storage and GPU hardware, relying on external network storage for persistent filesystem needs. Benchmark evaluations reveal conservative single-threaded metrics, including a Geekbench single-core score of 956.0, offset by balanced multi-threaded performance with a PassMark CPU score of 18251.16 and memory read bandwidth of 86.27 GB/sec. Delivering 21.19 million Redis SET operations per second, this 1:8 vCPU-to-memory configuration provides sufficient resource density for in-memory databases, data caching systems, ETL data tasks, and memory-bound enterprise backend applications.
